precedent.body: Summoning a monster whose properties are immediately changed

en.answer:
Yes, you can.

If you Special Summon a monster whose original Type is not Plant, but <<21821>>'s effect is applying, this is treated as you Special Summoning a Plant monster.
en.question:
Previously during this turn, I have Special Summoned a monster whose original Type is neither Dragon nor Plant. However, at the time, <<21821>>'s『all face-up monsters on the field become Plant monsters』effect was applying.

Can I now still activate <<22536>>'s effect, even though『you cannot Special Summon the turn you activate either of this card's effects, except Dragon or Plant monsters?』
en.title: If I have previously Special Summoned a monster that is not originally a Dragon or Plant monster, but <<21821>>'s effect was applying at the time, can I now still activate <<22536>>'s effect?

ja.answer:
発動できます。

「<<21821>>」の『②：フィールドの表側表示モンスターは植物族になる』効果適用中に元々の種族が植物族以外のモンスターを特殊召喚した場合でも、植物族モンスターを特殊召喚した扱いになるためです。
ja.question: 「<<21821>>」の『②：フィールドの表側表示モンスターは植物族になる』効果適用中に元々の種族がドラゴン族・植物族以外のモンスターを特殊召喚している場合、「<<22536>>」の効果は発動できますか？
ja.title: 「<<21821>>」の②の効果適用中に元々の種族がドラゴン族・植物族以外のモンスターを特殊召喚しているターンに、「<<22536>>」の効果を発動できますか？
